FIELDS.NAME: TeleCall Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At TeleCall Solutions, we specialize in providing comprehensive answering and telemarketing services tailored to the needs of small to medium-sized enterprises across various industries, including healthcare, retail, and financial services. Our operations are conducted from a dedicated office space equipped with state-of-the-art telecommunications and CRM software sourced from reputable vendors, ensuring robust data security and compliance with relevant regulations. We prioritize customer experience by employing standardized scripts and call monitoring practices to maintain quality and achieve satisfaction metrics. Our team is trained on risk management practices, including measures to secure high-value electronics, thus mitigating risks associated with theft and vandalism. We implement clear consumer opt-in procedures for all automated communications, adhering strictly to the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) and other applicable consumer protection laws. By maintaining transparency in our communication practices and consistently measuring performance metrics, we strive to deliver exceptional service and build lasting client relationships.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: TeleCall Solutions LLC owns "VirtualAssist Services," a subsidiary that provides virtual administrative support services to small businesses, operating out of the same facility and adhering to the same security and compliance standards as our telemarketing operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: As of the current reporting period, TeleCall Solutions experienced a minor operational incident on 06/10/2023, resulting from an accidental data entry error during a telemarketing campaign that led to a temporary customer dissatisfaction. The company incurred review and correction costs totaling $1,250. The issue has been resolved, and no further action is required. Current status: Closed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard lock and key system with electronic access control; equipped with motion sensors and alarm integration.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored alarm system in place with 24/7 security personnel to protect high-value electronics.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – TeleCall Solutions does not engage in any activities related to storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Our operations focus solely on providing telemarketing and answering services without involvement in hazardous materials management.

FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions for fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime associated with TeleCall Solutions or its operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – TeleCall Solutions has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. All insurance policies have been maintained without interruption.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – TeleCall Solutions does not lease employees to or from other employers; our team is exclusively composed of in-house staff dedicated to providing telemarketing and answering services.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – TeleCall Solutions currently does not carry Workers Compensation insurance as we operate with a legal exemption due to our structure and the nature of our workforce.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – TeleCall Solutions owns and operates another business, "VirtualAssist Services," which provides virtual administrative support services to small businesses and operates out of the same facility, adhering to the same security and compliance standards.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – TeleCall Solutions does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. All necessary coverage is provided under the current policy.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – TeleCall Solutions is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations strictly focus on providing telemarketing and answering services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – TeleCall Solutions does not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations focus on providing telemarketing and answering services without engaging in equipment rental.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – TeleCall Solutions has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. The company maintains a strong financial position without any significant financial distress.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – TeleCall Solutions does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations are confined to providing telemarketing and answering services, without any involvement in hazardous materials management.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – TeleCall Solutions does not have any exposure to catastrophes as our operations are primarily focused on providing telemarketing and answering services without involvement in high-risk activities or environments.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – TeleCall Solutions has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain strict policies and training to ensure a compliant and safe working environment.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – TeleCall Solutions has no uncorrected fire code violations and adheres to all relevant safety regulations to ensure a compliant and safe operating environment.
